recent_articles.title: FM Sitharaman says Government open to hear investor concerns on LTCG, STCG taxation - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman** stated that the government is open to receiving feedback and suggestions from investors regarding capital gains taxation.  She emphasized the government's willingness to listen to stakeholders on this issue, particularly amidst growing concerns over market participation and investor sentiment due to global geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainties. **Sitharaman** also clarified that recent petrol and diesel price hikes are driven by global procurement realities rather than policy changes, highlighting the government's commitment to protecting consumers from shocks.

recent_articles.title: CBSE again extends deadline for scanned answer book requests till May 25 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** extended the deadline for students to request scanned copies of their evaluated answer books for Class 12 board exams until May 25 midnight. The extension follows complaints from students about difficulties accessing the portal.  **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** sought support from the **Union Finance Ministry** to overhaul the CBSE payment gateway system and has directed IIT-Madras and IIT-Kanpur teams to assist in resolving technical issues.

recent_articles.title: Mega merger incoming: Should you buy PFC, REC shares ahead of merger? Here's what analysts say - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nirmala Sitharaman**, the **Union Finance Minister**, announced plans to restructure **Power Finance Corporation (PFC)** and **Rural Electrification Corporation (REC)** for streamlined operations. The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved a proposal where PFC acquired 52.63% of the government's holding in REC, consolidating them into a single balance sheet.  Analysts suggest investors consider staggered exposure to PFC and REC as the merger process is subject to regulatory approvals and structural adjustments. While PFC offers better visibility due to its parent status, REC presents a merger-arbitrage opportunity with higher event risk depending on the swap ratio.

recent_articles.title: Lawrence Bishnoi gang stakes claim on gunfire outside Diljit Dosanjh's manager in Karnal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Punjab Finance Minister Harpal Singh Cheema** alleged that the **Lawrence Bishnoi gang** was responsible for an alleged firing incident outside the residence of Diljit Dosanjh's manager in Haryana.  **Tyson Bishnoi, Arzoo Bishnoi, and Hari Boxer**, purportedly acting on behalf of the **Bishnoi gang**, claimed responsibility for the incident via social media. **Cheema** accused the **BJP** of using gangsters to intimidate Punjabis who refuse to join their party. The **Haryana Police** have not received a complaint from the manager or his family and found no evidence at the scene.

recent_articles.title: Israel widens Gaza control, plans more ops - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israel** has expanded its control of **Gaza**, now controlling 60% of the territory, according to officials.  Finance minister **Bezalel Smotrich** stated that this expansion is part of a strategy to deepen destruction of infrastructure and limit Hamas's ability to re-arm. The move comes despite a ceasefire agreement seven months ago aimed at rehabilitating the war-torn enclave, which has seen increased violence with continued Israeli airstrikes and Hamas resisting disarmament efforts.

recent_articles.title: Health Dept. suspends two faculty members in sexual harassment case - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Dr. Nori Ramasastry Government Ayurvedic Medical College Principal K. Nirmala Jyothibai
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Department of Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare** suspended **Assistant Professor D. Mouli Naik**, a laboratory technician **K. V. Subrahmanyam**, and removed **Dr. Nori Ramasastry Government Ayurvedic Medical College Principal K. Nirmala Jyothibai** and **Professor K. Vijayakumari** from their positions for alleged sexual harassment of a student at the college in Vijayawada.  **AYUSH In-charge Commissioner Ronanki Gopalakrishna** stated that further investigation is ongoing.

recent_articles.title: Sebi to expedite rule simplification, boost tech-led oversight: Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey on 38th anniversary - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi**'s chief, Pandey, emphasized the need for collaboration between regulators and market stakeholders to foster innovation and economic growth. He highlighted Sebi's evolution from an open outcry system to a technology-driven, transparent market through reforms like dematerialization and screen-based trading.  Pandey stressed that Indian markets have demonstrated resilience despite global uncertainties, but also acknowledged the need for balancing innovation with investor protection and sustainable development.  He emphasized recent reforms aimed at easing business, strengthening investor safeguards, and improving efficiency.

recent_articles.title: Consumption sustaining growth; predictable support essential for GDP expansion: Finance Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nirmala Sitharaman**, **Union Finance Minister**, stated that domestic consumption is driving India's economic growth and predictable policy support is crucial to maintain this momentum. She also emphasized the importance of supporting domestic manufacturing, agriculture, tourism, IT, and related services sectors for sustained growth.  Sitharaman highlighted the need for banks to focus on customer interaction as they expand globally and digitally while acknowledging the impact of the West Asia crisis on asset quality. The Finance Minister urged banks to collaborate on addressing the challenges posed by AI advancements like Anthropic's **Mythos** model, and addressed concerns about LPG supply.

recent_articles.title: Ex-Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Nadendla Bhaskara Rao dies at 90 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nadendla Bhaskara Rao**, a former Chief Minister of undivided Andhra Pradesh and co-founder of the Telugu Desam Party (TDP), died at a private hospital in Hyderabad on Wednesday, April 22, 2026. He was 90 years old and had been undergoing treatment for old-age-related ailments. His son, **Nadendla Manohar**, is the Minister for Civil Supplies, Food and Consumer Affairs in the TDP-led NDA government in Andhra Pradesh.  **Bhaskara Rao** played a key role in the formation of the TDP in 1982 and was later expelled from the party. He served as an MLA from various constituencies and also held positions in the Lok Sabha and BJP. His body will be kept at his residence for public viewing before being cremated on April 24th.

recent_articles.title: SC asks petitioner to move Madhya Pradesh HC to assist in contempt case against BJP MLA - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** granted a petitioner's request to withdraw his petition regarding criminal contempt proceedings against **BJP MLA Sanjay Satyendra Pathak**. The case stems from an allegation that the MLA attempted to contact a judge hearing an illegal mining case involving his companies.  The petitioner, Ashutosh Dixit, claimed he was excluded from the High Court proceedings and argued that the court's actions raised concerns about judicial independence. The **Supreme Court** emphasized the need to address the allegations through due legal process.

recent_articles.title: Cash incentives for women steer Bengal poll discourse - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: With less than seven days until the first phase of voting in West Bengal, **Trinamool Congress** and **Bharatiya Janata Party** are vying for women's votes with their respective welfare schemes. The **Trinamool Congress**’s Lakshmir Bhandar program has been a successful model for the party, offering ₹1,500 per month to eligible women.  The BJP countered with its Matri Shakti Vandan Yojana promising ₹3,000 per month, leading to clashes between supporters of both parties. **Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee** criticized the BJP's tactics and accused them of collecting voter information for undue advantage. The BJP defended their actions, stating that they were simply offering a better scheme than the Trinamool’s previous program.

recent_articles.title: Sasken Tech to hire 100 people for CoE in Hyderabad - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sasken Technologies** opened a center of excellence (CoE) in Hyderabad, India, to support advanced engineering programs for global customers. The CoE will focus on next-generation engineering across connected devices, 5G-led platforms, IoT solutions, embedded systems, and digital product engineering. **Nirmala Datla**, Chief Data Science and Engineering Officer at **Sasken Technologies**, will lead the Hyderabad CoE.  The company plans to hire 100 engineers initially for the facility.

recent_articles.title: Interesting battle on the cards in Madurai Central constituency - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: In the upcoming 2026 Assembly election for Madurai Central, incumbent MLA **Palanivel Thiaga Rajan** of the DMK faces competition from actor and director **Sundar. C**, who is running on the AIADMK's 'Two leaves' symbol.  Other candidates include K. Abdul Hakeem (Naam Tamilar Katchi), Madhar Badhurudeen (Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam), and P. Sakkaravarthy (All India Puratchi Thalaivar Makkal Munnettra Kazhagam). Rajan, who has won the seat in 2016 and 2021, is seeking a third consecutive victory.  The constituency faces issues such as traffic congestion, parking woes, lack of civic infrastructure, and poor maintenance of public spaces like Sri Meenakshi Sundareswarar temple and Thathaneri cremation grounds.
